name: conexus-tool-spill
description: Opt-in: a main-session Bash output or whole-file Read over a size limit is cut to its head and tail (Bash: the full text goes to a file), so a big read costs a few KB of context instead of all of it. Replaces any machine-local copy of the mod.

limit.title: Spill limit (bytes)
limit.description: A main-session Bash result or whole-file Read larger than this many bytes is cut. Results at or under it pass unchanged.

head.title: Head kept (bytes)
head.description: Bytes kept from the start of a cut result, trimmed back to a line end. With the tail it is scaled down to fit the spill limit.

tail.title: Tail kept (bytes)
tail.description: Bytes kept from the end of a cut Bash result, where a script's verdict usually sits. Zero or less restores the default.

includeHeadless.title: Cut headless runs too
includeHeadless.description: Also cut results in claude -p runs (nx_answer operators, headless critics). Off by default: a headless run has no one to follow the note.
